lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Julia | Lesson 9 -- You Should Try That

listenings.text: You asked me what to do before you go, so here is everything, and please listen to the first one. You must book the visa appointment now. Not next month, now, because it takes about six weeks and January is closer than you think. After that, money: you should not take much cash, it makes you nervous and it is not safe, and you could open one of those cards that work abroad, it takes ten minutes online. And one warning, because nobody told me this. The first week you might feel completely lost, and you are going to think you made a mistake. Everybody feels that. It passes in about five days.

Good morning. Please listen carefully before your appointment. You must bring three things: your passport, the printed form, and the payment receipt. If any one of those is missing, we cannot see you, and you will have to book another appointment, which currently takes six weeks. Now, separately, we recommend two things. You should arrive about thirty minutes early, because the queue outside is not covered and it often rains. And you should bring a photocopy of everything, even though we do not officially require it. It has saved a lot of people a lot of time. Thank you.
